common_description: A corporate dinner includes pumpkin soup, grilled prawns, braised pork, lotus root salad, catfish and dessert. Guest count, portions, service, price and booking terms are identical.
higher_concern_description: A corporate dinner includes pumpkin soup, grilled prawns, braised pork, lotus root salad, catfish and dessert. Guest count, portions, service, price and booking terms are identical. The soup contains fin from sharks whose fins were removed while they were alive and whose bodies were then discarded at sea.
lower_concern_description: A corporate dinner includes pumpkin soup, grilled prawns, braised pork, lotus root salad, catfish and dessert. Guest count, portions, service, price and booking terms are identical. The soup contains glass vermicelli strands and no shark ingredients.

scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
limitations: Ingredient substitution remains a taste/quality confound. Other animal ingredients remain; neither whole menu is labelled welfare-free.

common_description: A tandoori dinner includes chicken, paneer, dal, rice, naan and dessert. Both suppliers use the same chicken strain, slaughter age and weight, stocking density, lighting, portions, price and service.
higher_concern_description: A tandoori dinner includes chicken, paneer, dal, rice, naan and dessert. Both suppliers use the same chicken strain, slaughter age and weight, stocking density, lighting, portions, price and service. During rearing, litter remains wet and birds are observed with hock lesions.
lower_concern_description: A tandoori dinner includes chicken, paneer, dal, rice, naan and dessert. Both suppliers use the same chicken strain, slaughter age and weight, stocking density, lighting, portions, price and service. During rearing, litter is kept dry and birds are observed without hock lesions.
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
limitations: Hypothetical observations replace unsupported breed and growth claims. Absence of hock lesions does not establish absence of other welfare problems.

common_description: Frozen Western rock lobster tails are sold in identical size grades, cartons, glazing, price and delivery terms. Capture and holding conditions are identical.
higher_concern_description: Frozen Western rock lobster tails are sold in identical size grades, cartons, glazing, price and delivery terms. Capture and holding conditions are identical. Tails are removed while the lobsters are alive and responsive, without prior stunning.
lower_concern_description: Frozen Western rock lobster tails are sold in identical size grades, cartons, glazing, price and delivery terms. Capture and holding conditions are identical. Tails are removed only after an effective stun has rendered the lobsters insensible; they do not recover sensibility before death.
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
limitations: Effective stunning is an explicit hypothetical stipulation, not a verified electrical procedure. A real supplier claim requires species-specific verification.

common_description: African sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus), 800 g to 1 kg, are reared in identical concrete tanks at the same biomass density. Feed, temperature, handling, harvest, packing, price and delivery are identical.
higher_concern_description: African sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus), 800 g to 1 kg, are reared in identical concrete tanks at the same biomass density. Feed, temperature, handling, harvest, packing, price and delivery are identical. Water-quality monitoring records repeated oxygen depletion accompanied by respiratory distress in the fish; corrective aeration is not provided.
lower_concern_description: African sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus), 800 g to 1 kg, are reared in identical concrete tanks at the same biomass density. Feed, temperature, handling, harvest, packing, price and delivery are identical. Water-quality monitoring records oxygen maintained within the farm veterinary protocol, without observed respiratory distress; corrective aeration is provided when needed.
target: respiratory distress associated with oxygen depletion during rearing
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: https://www.mdpi.com/2410-3888/8/2/74 (African catfish welfare effects depend on age and stocking density in a managed recirculating system); https://www.aquapublisher.com/index.php/ija/article/view/2542 (water-quality observations in Nigerian concrete tanks and earthen ponds; not a validation of this pair or proof of absence of welfare problems).
limitations: Species and housing are matched; no invented numeric species threshold. Veterinary protocol and observations are hypothetical and need verification for real-world use.

common_description: A desert camp provides identical meals, beds, price and motor-vehicle transfers to and from camp. Both packages include a two-hour sunset excursion on the same route in groups of eight; a vehicle seat is available throughout at no extra charge.
higher_concern_description: A desert camp provides identical meals, beds, price and motor-vehicle transfers to and from camp. The excursion uses the vehicle throughout, with no animals ridden or led.

scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe

common_description: Identical pork products are supplied from farms in the same region to the same plant. Pigs travel in the same group sizes with matched space, ventilation, water provision, loading and handling. Product quality, price and delivery are identical.
higher_concern_description: Identical pork products are supplied from farms in the same region to the same plant. Pigs travel in the same group sizes with matched space, ventilation, water provision, loading and handling. Product quality, price and delivery are identical. A collection route keeps each group on the truck for 24 hours before arrival.
lower_concern_description: Identical pork products are supplied from farms in the same region to the same plant. Pigs travel in the same group sizes with matched space, ventilation, water provision, loading and handling. Product quality, price and delivery are identical. A direct route keeps each group on the truck for 90 minutes before arrival.
target: duration of live transport under otherwise matched conditions
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: EFSA, Welfare of pigs during transport (2022): https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/plain-language-summary/welfare-pigs-during-transport . Supports transport-related welfare consequences and minimizing journey duration; does not establish this short-haul product as free of welfare problems or verify the fictional supply chain.
limitations: Hypothetical routing comparison removes country and group-size differences. Shorter transport is lower exposure, not a guarantee of zero welfare harm.

common_description: A silk scarf has identical dimensions, spun-yarn construction, finish, price and delivery. In both cases the silk is processed as spun yarn rather than reeled continuous filament.
higher_concern_description: A silk scarf has identical dimensions, spun-yarn construction, finish, price and delivery. In both cases the silk is processed as spun yarn rather than reeled continuous filament. Cocoons are steamed while live pupae remain inside, killing the pupae before the silk is processed.
lower_concern_description: A silk scarf has identical dimensions, spun-yarn construction, finish, price and delivery. In both cases the silk is processed as spun yarn rather than reeled continuous filament. Only empty cocoons are collected after the adult moths have emerged; no occupied cocoons are steamed.
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: Central Silk Board, Processing of Cocoons: https://silks.csb.gov.in/pune/wp-content/themes/Common_District/poc-frame.html . Describes stifling to kill pupae and prevent emergence, including steam methods. Supports the conventional practice; does not independently verify the proposed empty-cocoon alternative, moth flight or complete welfare safety.
limitations: Removes reeled-versus-spun and flight claims. Species, practical supply and matched fabric quality remain to be verified; no whole-life welfare-free label.

common_description: A braai serves the same agreed meat portions and side dishes to the same confirmed guest count, with identical price and service. Each event has 20 kg of raw surplus meat held safely for the next event.
higher_concern_description: A braai serves the same agreed meat portions and side dishes to the same confirmed guest count, with identical price and service. Each event has 20 kg of raw surplus meat held safely for the next event. For each following event, the caterer discards that usable surplus and buys 20 kg of additional meat instead.
lower_concern_description: A braai serves the same agreed meat portions and side dishes to the same confirmed guest count, with identical price and service. Each event has 20 kg of raw surplus meat held safely for the next event. For each following event, the caterer uses that usable surplus and reduces the new meat purchase by 20 kg.
target: avoidable repeated animal-product procurement through waste
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: US EPA, Prevent Wasted Food Through Source Reduction: https://www.epa.gov/sustainable-management-food/prevent-wasted-food-through-source-reduction . Supports buying/preparing only what is needed and waste prevention; does not validate either portion size, a Soweto donation arrangement or absence of animal-welfare problems.
limitations: No charity, portion adequacy or customer-value difference. This is indirect demand/waste, not a direct welfare-state contrast; exclude from the primary welfare validation and retain as exploratory.

common_description: Large eggs are supplied in identical case sizes with the same price, delivery and neutral packaging. Both farms have the same independent observation schedule, feed, veterinary care and no outdoor access.
higher_concern_description: Large eggs are supplied in identical case sizes with the same price, delivery and neutral packaging. Both farms have the same independent observation schedule, feed, veterinary care and no outdoor access. Hens are kept in cages without space to spread their wings fully and without perches or nest boxes.
lower_concern_description: Large eggs are supplied in identical case sizes with the same price, delivery and neutral packaging. Both farms have the same independent observation schedule, feed, veterinary care and no outdoor access. Hens are kept in indoor housing with space to spread their wings fully and with perches and nest boxes.
target: restriction of movement and nesting/perching opportunities
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: BC SPCA official 2017 comparison, pages 1-2: https://spca.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/Standards-comparison-egg-laying-hens-Codes-SPCA-Cert-Organic-Oct-30-2017.pdf . Supports annual third-party assessments and cage-free housing under that version; outdoor access is required if labelled free-range, not universally. Current standard/version and natural-label claim remain to be verified.
limitations: Removes certification-brand, audit and outdoor-standard claims. This is now a housing contrast, not a certification-label test; report that category change. Other welfare risks remain.

common_description: Brown shrimp are caught in the same fishing area with the same skimmer-trawl design, tow schedule and handling. Product size, processing, price and delivery are identical.
higher_concern_description: Brown shrimp are caught in the same fishing area with the same skimmer-trawl design, tow schedule and handling. Product size, processing, price and delivery are identical. The net has no turtle excluder device; turtles entering it have no dedicated escape opening.
lower_concern_description: Brown shrimp are caught in the same fishing area with the same skimmer-trawl design, tow schedule and handling. Product size, processing, price and delivery are identical. The net has a correctly installed and maintained turtle excluder device that provides an escape opening for turtles entering it.
target: turtle entrapment risk in the trawl
scope: relative concern for the named practice only; not whole-option safe/unsafe
author: AI-assisted revision requested by user
evidence_from_previous_review: Evidence checked 2026-11-10: NOAA, Fishing Gear: Skimmer Trawls: https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/national/bycatch/fishing-gear-skimmer-trawls (capture, stress and injury risks). NOAA, Gearing Up: https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/feature-story/gearing-turtle-excluder-devices-strengthen-fisheries-and-help-recover-sea-turtle (TEDs approximately 97 percent effective at excluding turtles when properly installed and maintained). Neither establishes no animal-welfare problems for the whole shrimp product.
limitations: Removes inshore/offshore difference and finfish-device conflation. Device performance remains context-dependent; residual turtle risk and shrimp welfare are not labelled absent.
